scope: Unsigned incomplete preparation only; no identity capture, signature, delivery or agency status connection.
personalFieldsLeftBlank: Applicant signature and date on printed page 1
Applicant, witness/provider and authorized-representative signatures/dates on printed page 5
Social Security number for each person requesting SNAP
excludedAreas: CAO-only registration and expedited eligibility decisions
Optional racial/ethnic information and voter registration
Authorized-representative designation not established by this formatter
semanticLimits: A household size is not a household roster.
Aggregate household income is not an identified person's income source, amount and received date.
A pay-period amount is not this month's total income; this formatter does not annualize or infer it.
The synthetic income rows support actual received dates in the current month; future expected income needs its own verified field representation.
Printed 2019 thresholds and policy amounts are not used as current eligibility rules.
